This week, Anthropic is going public, [listing 825 million shares on the
Nasdaq at a price of around $70-$78 per
share](https://www.ft.com/content/7974acec-e378-4298-a1a7-2b16b00d8b32?syn-25a6b1a6=1).
At the targeted [valuation of up to $1.4
trillion](https://www.reuters.com/business/anthropic-ipo-raise-
much-644-billion-latest-draft-prospectus-shows-2026-11-10/), the Anthropic
listing would be the [world's largest-
ever](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2026-11-15/anthropic-s-ipo-
makes-dario-amodei-the-new-face-of-the-ai-boom) stock market debut, or IPO.
Anthropic will be the first standalone AI lab to go public in the U.S., and
investors will view its performance as a test of the AI trade as a whole.

The company is going public at a rocky time for the AI trade. Last week, the
scandal engulfing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang wiped [$430
billion](https://news.sky.com/story/jensen-huang-nvidias-value-plummets-430bn-
in-two-days-as-ceo-urged-to-quit-13610814) off the company's value over the
course of just two days. The week before that, the blue wave in the U.S.
midterms [stoked fears that data centre construction would
stall](https://www.businessinsider.com/blue-wave-data-center-slowdown-impact-
on-ai-trade-2026-11), catalysing a sell-off that sent the tech-heavy [Nasdaq
index down 5.5% in a
day](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/06/global-stocks-
tumble-ai-panic-markets-democrats-midterms-success-jobs-oil-dollar-latest-
news-updates). In October[, the Nasdaq fell by
5.3%](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-
october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-amazon-intel-ai-sell-off-191429143.html) on fears
that the data centre buildout was entering bubble territory.

This kind of volatility is exactly what you would expect to see during the
later stages of a financial bubble. Valuations have become divorced from
earnings; [debt is starting to pile
up](https://www.goldmansachs.com/insights/goldman-sachs-exchanges/how-ai-debt-
is-reshaping-the-credit-market); investors are [insuring
themselves](https://graceblakeley.substack.com/p/the-big-short-ai-edition)
against potential defaults; [CEOs are making outlandish
claims](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/dario-amodei-says-ai-
cure-172853885.html) about the revolutionary potential of the technology; and
cash is circulating between the big players in a way that [looks suspiciously
circular](https://graceblakeley.substack.com/p/the-ai-circular-economy). The
data centre buildout is also starting to [hit its physical - and political -
limits](https://graceblakeley.substack.com/p/the-new-standard-
oil?r=2w74y&utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=post%20viewer), with
immense costs for the rest of society.
